english: Then, O Daughter of the Mountain, as soon as the speech of the king concluded, all over the royal assembly hall crores and crores of creatures were seen. There were mosquitoes, bugs, lice, bees, birds, animals, both domesticated and wild, such as horses, cows, mares, lions, tigers, buffaloes and others as well. On seeing such a multitude of living beings, the king became mystified in his mind. When he reflected, ‘what could this be?’ he suddenly realized everything and knew the greatness of Jaigīṣavya and the noble-souled Kapila.
